newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes lower on seeding pace.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes lower on seeding pace.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower on active seeding of the U.S. spring wheat crop under nearly ideal wheat crop weather, traders said.
USDA on Monday said that as of Sunday, the U.S. spring wheat crop was 59 percent seeded, above the year ago pace of 45 percent but below the five year average pace of 70 percent.
Aggressive seeding of the crop was expected this week, traders said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1-1/4 to 5-1/4 cents lower, with July down 5-1/4 at $3.99 per bushel. September settled down 4-1/2 at $3.98-1/2.
Wheat futures volume was estimated by the MGE at 17.510 million bushels, below the 18.239 traded Wednesday.
MGE barley futures closed $0.10 to $0.20 cent lower, with July down $0.20 at $6.50 per cwt.
